newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves investment for coalfields expansion.
newsitem.headline: India approves investment for coalfields expansion.

text.p: The Indian government has approved a proposal for capital investment of 4.6 billion rupees ($129 million) for expansion of an opencast project in the South Eastern coalfields, an official statement said on Thursday.
It said the expansion of the Dipka project would help in achieving an annual target capacity of 10 million tonnes of coal.
"The coal produced will be supplied mainly to pithead and Western India power stations," the statement said.
It said the project would provide employment to 2,100 persons.
